description: The Aeronautical Information Exchange Model (AIXM) is a data model for providing aeronautical information in digital form, within the scope of Aeronautical Information Services. Its website is maintained jointly by EUROCONTROL and the US Federal Aviation Administration. AIXM supports the move from paper products and messages to digital data by enabling collection, verification, dissemination and transformation of aeronautical data along the data chain, in particular towards the next intended user. Its information areas include aerodromes and heliports with movement areas, services and facilities. The site documents the versions in use, AIXM 5.2, 5.1 and 5.1.1, 5.0 and 4.5, with data coding guidelines, business rules, Digital NOTAM, implementation support, open-source projects, commercial products, viewers and data verification, and offers the script that generates the AIXM 5.1.1 XML Schema from the UML model. Related models cover airport mapping databases (AMXM). Coverage: global standard. Format and access: UML and XML Schema documentation, free online; the forum needs registration. Licence and cost: free to use; no licence text was found on the pages read. Caveats: a standard, not data; national AIS publish data in it. It supports network flow and digital twin models of airspace and airports. The delorean-aixm tool in the catalogue reads AIXM data, and OurAirports offers simpler airport data.
